purpose: Perform one bounded, profiler-supported runtime fusion after the exact quality-passing v44 artifact missed the sealed-parent sustained-throughput retention floor by less than one percentage point.

single_allowed_change.down_projection: Replace the five-operator quantized arithmetic sequence with one DynamicQuantizeMatMul using the identical activation, gathered int8 weight, gathered per-channel scale, and zero point.

screen_order: Validate the derived ONNX graph and run paired active-state equivalence probes.
Require exact generated outputs, token IDs, routes, ABI-state arrays, and cache arrays on the locked diagnostic prompts.
Only after speed passes, rerun full functional quality, general preservation, headline performance, physical proof, identity, and adversarial generation.
promotion_rule: The exact fused artifact must preserve every v44 gate and reach at least 95 percent of the sealed Phase 2 parent sustained median, at least 2x Qwen with paired bootstrap lower bound at least 2x, lower active memory, no worse TTFT, and RSS below the locked ceiling.
failure_rule: Any state/output mismatch or failed gate closes this one fusion branch; do not sweep session knobs or arithmetic variants.
